privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: Site Visit Companion — Data Protection & Privacy Notice
privacy.p1: The Site Visit Companion is designed for field technicians and authorized personnel to record site survey information, upload field media, and prepare project installation reports.
privacy.p2: All data and media recorded are processed securely under strict company-level access controls and are retained in compliance with project data protection guidelines.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.subtitle: Site Visit Companion — User Agreement
terms.p1: Access to the Site Visit Companion is restricted to authenticated and approved personnel. Account registrations require administrator authorization.
terms.p2: By using this application, technicians and administrators agree to input accurate technical installation data and safeguard project confidential materials.
